'''R. Smith The People s Court''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[R. Smith]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-3390">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3390 The People s Court], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 17 February 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/3390/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/3390/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018202626/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3390/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[R. Smith]]
* '''Published:''' 17 February 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''The People s Court''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Vile Smith DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' CotVG deck that can battle and drain. Sense/Alter for fun.
